title: What subtracting two dates gives you
prompt: What does this return? Read it — do not run it.

explanation.approach: Not a number — a Period, printed as `PT672H`. It is an elapsed duration held in hours, and 672 hours is 28 days. This is why the answer cannot just be `end - start`.
